The Minikahda Club sits on the banks of the **Mississippi River** in Minneapolis, Minnesota.  
The Mississippi River meets the Ohio River at **Cairo, Illinois**—the confluence is located at the southern tip of Illinois, where the Ohio enters the Mississippi.
